rust_summary: the glowing outline a client draws on an entity (`native_entity_outline`).
doc_summary:
the glowing outline a client draws on an entity (`native_entity_outline(entity_id, kind, outline)`): vanilla's
`isCurrentlyGlowing` and team colour come in as `Some(0xRRGGBB)` or None, and a mod sets `Some` to make any mob,
player, dropped item or projectile glow in its own colour, or None to remove the outline. Drawing only: the entity's
`Glowing` flag is unchanged. Bundles need "hooks": @API:entity_outline@.
